claim: In major Hindu tantric traditions focused on Shiva, meditation—including visualization and practices centered on pure awareness—forms an integral part of ritual and soteriological practice.
bounded_by: This is limited to major Shaiva-oriented tantric traditions described by Flood. It does not universalize one meditation model to all Shaivism or establish historical transmission to Sri Lankan Theravada practice.
notes: Run34 forced resolution of the former creolisation draft; retained as a comparative source fact rather than evidence of syncretism.
